atAGlance: Soda chanh is lime soda, fizzy, sharp, sweet, and a classic Vietnamese café answer to hot weather.
whatItIs: Soda chanh is soda water mixed with lime and sugar. Expect lime soda that is fizzy, sharp, sweet, and refreshing.
howToEnjoy: Stir well so the sugar dissolves before you judge the sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Order soda chanh when you want fizzy lime. Ask ít đường, ít đá, or khuấy đều if you want less syrup, less ice, or a better mixed glass.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese cafés, soda chanh is a classic because lime, fizz, sugar, and ice make a bright hot-weather drink without feeling heavy.
